lines.en: label undeservedfuture5:
scene himadate1
: An arcade? {i}This{/i} is where you wanted to go? Why?
lines.zh: : 游戏中心？你想来的就是{i}这{/i}儿？为什么？

lines.en: : Because I am a fun-loving, quirky girl on a mission to make as many memories as possible with her father before he gets too old and dies.
lines.zh: : 因为我是一个爱玩又古怪的女孩，我的使命是在爸爸老死之前，跟他制造尽可能多的回忆。

lines.en: scene himadate2
: Plus, I have you all to myself today and I want you to watch me wipe the floor with old people on the mahjong machines.
lines.zh: : 再说，今天你是我一个人的，我想让你看着我在麻将机上把老爷爷老奶奶打得落花流水。

lines.en: : {size=-1}This sounds like it would be a good moment to teach you to always respect your elders but, honestly, I’m just thankful to be the only senior citizen in this room that you aren’t trying to turn into a fool.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}这本该是个教你尊敬长辈的好时机，不过说实话，我挺庆幸自己是这屋里唯一一个你没打算耍着玩的老头。{/size}

lines.en: : It’s less that I’m trying to make them look like fools and more the fact that my hobbies just don’t really mesh well with other girls my age. Old people, though? {i}They{/i} get me.
lines.zh: : 与其说是我想让他们出洋相，不如说我的爱好跟同龄女生实在合不来。不过老爷爷老奶奶？{i}他们{/i}懂我。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad at least someone does because I didn’t even know that you knew how to play mahjong until literally right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴至少有人懂。因为我直到刚刚这一秒才知道你居然会打麻将。

lines.en: scene himadate3
: I actually don’t. I am a liar. You have raised a rotten girl who doesn’t know how to tell the truth. I come here to smoke cigarettes and partake in underage drinking in the purikura booths.
lines.zh: : 其实我不会。我是个骗子。你把一个连真话都不会说的坏女孩养大了。我来这儿是为了抽烟，还有在大头贴机里未成年饮酒。

lines.en: : That’s more like it. No child of mine is going to hang out with old people. Now, let’s go get smashed and then forget to tell your mother about it.
lines.zh: : 这才像话。我的孩子可不会跟老年人混在一起。走，咱们去喝个烂醉，然后「忘了」告诉你妈。

lines.en: scene himadate4
: Finally, I get to act as a {i}proper{/i} high school dropout and not the kind who spends most of her days watching various Netflix documentaries with her dad!
lines.zh: : 终于，我可以当一个{i}正经{/i}的高中辍学生了，而不是那种整天跟爸爸一起看各种 Netflix 纪录片的辍学生！

lines.en: : You’ll learn more from those than you will from me. There’s nothing left for me to teach you, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 那些东西能教你的比我多。不幸的是，我已经没什么可以教你的了。

lines.en: scene himadate5
: All part of the plan, of course. I knew what I was doing when I came to you guys about quitting school. And I regret nothing since {i}now{/i} we get to do stuff like this during weekdays!
lines.zh: : 当然，这一切都在计划之中。我来找你们说退学的时候，就清楚自己在做什么。我一点都不后悔，因为{i}现在{/i}我们工作日也能做这种事了！

lines.en: : Just remember that we can’t make this into a regular thing and that we’re only here because the Internet is down. I’m still giving you a quiz tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 记住，这种事不能变成常态，我们今天来只是因为断网了。明天我还是要考你的。

lines.en: : And I’ll still ace it because I’m the best. Which means we’ve got a full day’s worth of daddy-daughter festivities to get to before we have to think about {i}learning{/i} at all!
lines.zh: : 我还是会拿满分，因为我是最棒的。也就是说，在开始考虑{i}学习{/i}之前，我们有一整天的父女庆典要过呢！

lines.en: : You’re right. I’ll go buy the alcohol now since you’re not legally allowed to yet.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我去买酒，反正你还不到合法年龄。

lines.en: scene himadate6
: Sounds good, Dad! I’ll go find us an empty purikura booth to-
lines.zh: : 好的，爸爸！我去找一个空着的大头贴机——

lines.en: scene himadate7
: AAAAAHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : What is it? You don’t see someone from school, do-
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你不会是看到了学校里的人吧——

lines.en: : RABBIT!
lines.zh: : 兔子！

lines.en: : ...Rabbit?
scene himadate8
: {i}This{/i} is what you were freaking out about? Why?
lines.zh: : 你就是为了{i}这个{/i}大呼小叫？为什么？

lines.en: : Because I’ve finally found the perfect opportunity for you to prove your manliness and provide for me by satisfying the instinctive masculine urge to win crane game prizes for a cute girl!
lines.zh: : 因为我终于找到了一个完美的机会，让你证明自己的男子气概、供养我——满足那种想给可爱女孩抓娃娃的本能冲动！

lines.en: : It is true that this is a thing I feel compelled to do. But I think that is less because you are cute and more because you are-
lines.zh: : 我确实有种非做不可的冲动。不过我觉得那与其说是因为你可爱，不如说是因为你——

lines.en: : The light of your life?
lines.zh: : 是你生命中的光？

lines.en: : Close. I was going to say, “because you are going to whine about it all day if I don’t.”
lines.zh: : 接近了。我本来想说的是，「因为我要是不抓，你会念叨一整天」。

lines.en: : That’s not even remotely close. Be nicer to me. Your time on this planet is limited and I’ll be reluctant to handle your funeral arrangements if you don’t make me the center of your world.
lines.zh: : 这点都不算接近。对我好一点。你在这个星球上的时间有限，如果不把我当成你世界的中心，我可不太乐意替你操办后事。

lines.en: : Are you sure this is what you want? There are a bunch of other crane games around here with less, uh...{i}vintage{/i} plushes in them.
lines.zh: : 你确定要这个？这附近还有一堆别的抓娃娃机，里面的玩偶……呃……没这么{i}有年头{/i}。

lines.en: : I have set my sights on this one. Win it for me and prove your love, Father. I have no choice but to doubt it until this object is in my hands.
lines.zh: : 我就看中这个了。给我抓到它，证明你的爱，父亲。在这东西到我手里之前，我只能一直怀疑。

lines.en: scene himadate9
: If you insist.
lines.zh: : 既然你坚持。

lines.en: : Yes! Go, go, go! Do the dad thing! Get it in one shot and you might finally usurp Mom’s role as my favorite!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！上上上！拿出当爸的样子！一次就抓到，你说不定就能篡夺妈妈作为我最喜欢的人的地位！

lines.en: : I think I’ll fail for her sake then. So when I don’t get it on the first try, know that it’s because I’m just being considerate and not that I’m bad at this.
lines.zh: : 那我看在她份上还是失手吧。所以如果我第一次没抓到，你要知道那只是因为我体贴，不是因为我不擅长。

lines.en: scene himadate10

: {size=-2}Don’t worry, Dad. Because even if you {i}do{/i} suck, you can still win through the act of persistence by failing so many times that an employee feels bad for you and comes over here to position the prize on the ledge.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}别担心，爸爸。因为就算你很菜，你还能靠坚持取胜——失败太多次，店员会同情你，过来把奖品摆到洞口边上。{/size}

lines.en: : Are you speaking from experience here, Himawari?
lines.zh: : 你这是经验之谈吗，Himawari？

lines.en: : Me? Who is good at {i}everything?{/i} Pfft. As if. There’s no way that happened to me every Wednesday after school for an entire month. I was too busy smoking cigarettes. Remember?
lines.zh: : 我？那个{i}什么都{/i}在行的我？哼。怎么可能。那种事绝对不可能整一个月里每个星期三放学都发生在我身上。我忙着抽烟呢。记得吗？

lines.en: : And where are you getting the money for those cigarettes exactly? We don’t give you an allowance.
lines.zh: : 那你买烟的钱到底是从哪儿来的？我们可没给你零花钱。

lines.en: scene himadate11
: I have ten online boyfriends who send me money in exchange for ASMR goodnight messages, obviously. All the girls my age are doing it, Dad. Respect the hustle.
lines.zh: : 显然啊，我有十个网恋男友，他们给我打钱，换我的 ASMR 晚安语音。跟我同岁的女孩都在干这个，爸爸。请尊重我的赚钱之道。

lines.en: : I’m going to need you to hand over your phone now.
lines.zh: : 那我现在需要你把手机交出来。

lines.en: scene himadate12
: But that’s where I keep all my pictures of {i}you!{/i} And my super secret diary about how much I love you and how awesome you are! It’d be, like, {i}so{i} embarrassing if you read all of that!
lines.zh: : 可我所有{i}你{/i}的照片都存在里面啊！还有我的超级秘密日记，里面写了我有多爱你、你有多棒！你要是全都看了，那也太……太丢人了！

lines.en: scene himadate13
: Move the claw already. The timer is going to run out.
lines.zh: : 快点移动爪子啊。时间要到了。

lines.en: scene himadate14
: Hi, Mom! Just checking in to make sure you’re still beautiful. And, would you look at that? You still are! Perhaps even more so than this morning.
lines.zh: : 嗨，妈妈！我只是想确认一下你还美不美。然后，你看看？你还是美！说不定比今天早上更美。

lines.en: : {i}Thank you, Hima-chan. I needed that today and- wait, where are you right now?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢你，Hima 酱。我今天正需要这句话，不过——等等，你们现在在哪儿？{/i}

lines.en: scene himadate15
: On a date with Dad. Internet went out. Look at the plushie he won me.
lines.zh: : 在跟爸爸约会。家里断网了。看看他给我抓的玩偶。

lines.en: scene himadate16
: I’ve decided to name him Che Guevara. And no, I will not elaborate.
lines.zh: : 我决定给他起名叫 Che Guevara。不，我不会解释。

lines.en: : {i}Himawari, it’s a school day. You promised that you were still going to take your education seriously after dropping out. It’s one of the main reasons we agreed to-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Himawari，今天是上学日。你答应过退学之后也会认真对待学业的。那是我们同意的主要理由之一——{/i}

lines.en: scene himadate17
: I {i}am{/i} taking it seriously! Dad’s giving me a quiz tomorrow and everything. Plus, you know what they say about mental health. I see this outing as an investment, if anything.
lines.zh: : 我很认真啊！爸爸明天还要给我测验什么的呢。再说了，大家都说心理健康很重要。要说的话，我觉得这次出门{i}是{/i}一种投资。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...Are you having fun, at least? You look cute today.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈……至少你玩得开心吧？你今天看起来很可爱。{/i}

lines.en: scene himadate18
: Don’t I? I’m wearing one of your old necklaces. Which is poetic in a sense because you might have been wearing it when you created me.
lines.zh: : 是吧？我戴着你以前的一条项链。从某种意义上说这很有诗意，因为你说不定就是戴着它造出我的。

lines.en: : {i}Are you two going to be home for dinner? Or should I pick something up for myself on the way home from work?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们俩回来吃晚饭吗？还是我下班路上自己买点什么？{/i}

lines.en: : You won’t be mad at me if I keep him all day, will you? We’re having a lot of fun and there’s somewhere else I want to go after this.
lines.zh: : 我要是霸占他一整天，你不会生气吧？我们玩得很开心，之后我还想去别的地方。

lines.en: : {i}Of course not. Just don’t stay out too late, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然不会。只是别太晚回来，好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. You’ll get him back before bed. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 好好好。睡觉前就把他还给你。别担心。

lines.en: : {i}Hima-chan, that’s not-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Hima 酱，我不是那个——{/i}

lines.en: scene himadate19
: Anyway, gotta run! Dad’s back! Love you!
lines.zh: : 总之，我先挂了！爸爸回来了！爱你！

lines.en: : {i}Himawari-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Himawari——{/i}

lines.en: scene himadate20
: {i}End call.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}通话结束。{/i}

lines.en: : You didn’t just hang up on your mother, did you?
lines.zh: : 你刚才该不会是挂了你妈的电话吧？

lines.en: : It’s rude to talk on the phone during a date.
lines.zh: : 约会的时候打电话是很没礼貌的。

lines.en: scene himadate21
: It’s rude to talk on the phone in a restaurant either way. But I think hanging up on one’s mother might trump that.
lines.zh: : 在餐厅里打电话不管怎样都不礼貌。不过我觉得挂妈妈的电话可能比那更过分。

lines.en: : What’s done is done. Now, what is the bountiful feast you have prepared for us today? Chicken skewers and onigiri, I see. But what rests within these balls of rice, I wonder?
lines.zh: : 木已成舟。那么，你今天为我们准备了什么丰盛大餐？鸡肉串和饭团，我看到了。可我想知道，这些饭团里包的是什么？

lines.en: : Ume for both. They didn’t have ikura, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 两个都是梅子。可惜没有鲑鱼籽。

lines.en: scene himadate22
: I accept this compromise for ume is my {i}second{/i} favorite fish.
lines.zh: : 我接受这个折中，因为梅子是我{i}第二{/i}喜欢的鱼。

lines.en: : Your second favorite fish is a plum?
lines.zh: : 你第二喜欢的鱼是一颗梅子？

lines.en: : That shouldn’t come as that big of a surprise considering my first favorite is an egg.
lines.zh: : 既然我最喜欢的是蛋，这也就没那么意外了吧。

lines.en: scene himadate23
: Is that beer for me? Thanks, Dad!
lines.zh: : 那杯啤酒是给我的吗？谢啦，爸爸！

lines.en: : Drink your soda. This is mine. You’re forbidden from partaking outside of photo booths.
lines.zh: : 喝你的汽水。这杯是我的。除了在拍照亭里，你哪儿都不许碰。

lines.en: scene himadate24
: I accept this compromise for Coca Cola is my {i}third{/i} favorite fish.
lines.zh: : 我接受这个折中，因为可口可乐是我{i}第三{/i}喜欢的鱼。

lines.en: : I really wonder how you turned out like this. Your mother’s weirdness only manifested in her just always having a gun for some reason.
lines.zh: : 我真好奇你怎么会长成这样。你妈的怪异之处就只体现在她不知为什么总是随身带把枪。

lines.en: scene himadate25
: Seriously? Who {i}does{/i} that?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？谁{i}会{/i}那样啊？

lines.en: : Himawari, put that down.
lines.zh: : Himawari，把那个放下。

lines.en: scene himadate26
: Already? But I just met him...
lines.zh: : 这么快？可我刚认识他……

lines.en: : Himawari...
lines.zh: : Himawari……

lines.en: : Look out over the river and picture it, Lennie...
lines.zh: : 望着河的那一边，想象一下吧，Lennie……

lines.en: : I thought you named the rabbit Che Guevara?
lines.zh: : 你不是给兔子起名叫 Che Guevara 吗？

lines.en: scene himadate27

: {size=-2}I did. But I wasn’t about to pass up an opportunity to add some aesthetic irony to a classic novel. Lennie being a rabbit would have made imagining {i}other{/i} rabbits a little more poignant, don’t you think?{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}是的。但我可不会放过给一部经典小说加点美学反讽的机会。Lennie 如果是只兔子，想象别的兔子时就会更有感染力，你不觉得吗？{/size}

lines.en: : Plus, Che Guevara was killed by a gunshot wound and I didn’t want to potentially upset any Cuban revolutionaries in the room.
lines.zh: : 再说，Che Guevara 是被枪打死的，我可不想万一惹到在场的古巴革命者。

lines.en: : Fair enough. There are a lot of those in Aomori.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。Aomori 那种人可不少。

lines.en: : Sure are, Dad. But winter is just around the corner at this point and I’m sure they’ll all go back into hiding soon enough. It gets way colder here than it does in Cuba.
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛，爸爸。不过眼看冬天就要到了，他们肯定很快就会躲起来的。这里可比古巴冷多了。

lines.en: : On that note, are you excited for Hokkaido? It’s right around the corner at this point.
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你期待去 Hokkaido 吗？眼看也要到了。

lines.en: scene himadate28
: Heck yeah, I am! Mom said she’s finally going to teach me how to ski!
lines.zh: : 那还用说！妈妈说她终于要教我滑雪了！

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize {i}she{/i} knew how to ski. But she comes from a rich family, so I guess it makes sense.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道{i}她{/i}会滑雪。不过她出身富裕家庭，所以倒也说得通。

lines.en: scene himadate29
: Did you ever get to meet Grandpa before he died, Dad? Or did you sort of avoid that drama on account of being an adult who impregnated his teenage daughter?
lines.zh: : 爸爸，你在外公死之前见过他吗？还是说你因为是个把自己十几岁的女儿搞怀孕的成年人，所以躲开了那摊烂事？

lines.en: : I never really had any desire to. Your mom never had much nice to say about him after the whole bubble wrap thing took off.
lines.zh: : 我从来就没那个念头。自从气泡纸那件事闹大之后，你妈就没说过他什么好话。

lines.en: : Still crazy that’s what killed him in the end. Who’d have thought that even unpoppable bubble wrap is poppable with enough force?
lines.zh: : 最后竟然是那玩意要了他的命，还是挺离谱的。谁能想到，连捏不爆的气泡纸，用力够大也是能捏爆的？

lines.en: : Well, we certainly know who {i}wouldn’t.{/i} Now, eat your food before it gets cold.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们当然知道谁{i}想不到{/i}。好了，趁热把饭吃了。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine, fine. Thanks for looking out for me, Dad. I- mnghhhfpphffhpphh?!??!! This isn’t ume at all! Is this...mngh! This onigiri is just filled with wasabi!
lines.zh: : 好好好。谢谢照顾我，爸爸。我——唔唔唔噗噗？？？！！这根本不是梅子！这难道是……唔！这个饭团里全是芥末！

lines.en: : You are not the only one here who doesn’t know how to tell the truth, Himawari. Your father is just as rotten as you are.
lines.zh: : 这里不会说真话的可不止你一个，Himawari。你爸爸跟你一样坏。

lines.en: : Mmmmmmnghhh!!!! I really {i}am{/i} calling CPS this time!!!!!
lines.zh: : 唔唔唔唔唔嗯！！！这次我{i}真的{/i}要打 CPS 了！！！！！

lines.en: The two of us gorge ourselves on food that Ayane only seldom allows in the house, taking our time to savor each and every bite since we know that moments like this are rare.
lines.zh: 我们俩狼吞虎咽地吃着 Ayane 平时很少允许出现在家里的食物，慢慢品味每一口，因为我们知道这样的时刻很稀有。

lines.en: And that sooner or later, they’ll be little more than a thing of the past. Once our bodies start becoming less tolerant of sodium and fat and even time itself.
lines.zh: 而迟早，它们也不过是过眼云烟。等到我们的身体开始不再那么耐受钠、脂肪，甚至时间本身的时候。

lines.en: It’s things like this that make it easier to get lost in a moment — so immersed in {i}now{/i} that the mere {i}idea{/i} of “later” is an entirely foreign concept.
lines.zh: 就是这样的时刻，让人更容易迷失在当下——沉浸于{i}此刻{/i}，以至于「以后」这个{i}概念{/i}完全陌生。

lines.en: I’m starting to wish things would stay that way.
lines.zh: 我开始希望事情能一直这样下去。

lines.en: scene himadate30
Every day, it seems less likely that I’ll be leaving this place.
lines.zh: 每过一天，我离开这里的可能性似乎就更小一点。

lines.en: That, somehow or another, this girl {i}did{/i} save me when she ushered us through a door on that rooftop months ago.
lines.zh: 不管怎么说，几个月前那个女孩领着我们穿过天台那扇门时，{i}确实{/i}救了我。

lines.en: Which means that time is moving again. The weather is changing and {i}I{/i} am getting older. {i}She{/i} is getting older.
lines.zh: 这意味着时间又开始流动了。天气在变，{i}我{/i}在变老。{i}她{/i}也在变老。

lines.en: The years will go by and I will see her less and less as they do. And, one day, she’ll have a family of her own to merge into mine.
lines.zh: 岁月流逝，她会越来越少出现在我眼前。而总有一天，她会有自己的家庭，融入我的家庭。

lines.en: I’m sure we’ll spend Christmases together since Ayane loves them so much. I’m excited to see if Himawari is the same.
lines.zh: 我相信我们会一起过圣诞节，因为 Ayane 那么喜欢。我很期待看看 Himawari 是不是也一样。

lines.en: But I want it to end there for I am once again {i}afraid{/i} of the passage of time now that I’ve been reminded of how it feels.
lines.zh: 但我希望就到此为止——因为重新体会到时间的流逝是什么感觉之后，我又开始{i}害怕{/i}它了。

lines.en: I am afraid that one day I will wake up and I won’t hear her footsteps anymore. That she’ll stop teasing me and begin to scorn me for my reluctance to let her go.
lines.zh: 我害怕有一天醒来，再也听不到她的脚步声。害怕她不再逗我，转而嫌弃我不肯放手。

lines.en: I’m afraid of a world in which she sees my name appear on her phone and doesn’t pick up on the first ring. Buying fewer groceries. What to do with her room when she moves out.
lines.zh: 我害怕有一天她看到手机上是我的名字，却不再第一时间接起。害怕买的东西越来越少。害怕她搬走之后，她的房间该怎么处理。

lines.en: It’s funny, though.
lines.zh: 不过，也挺可笑的。

lines.en: Because I {i}used{/i} to think I was afraid of everything...but it wasn’t until I met her that those fears multiplied by a number so large I can’t even properly {i}think{/i} it.
lines.zh: 因为我{i}曾经{/i}以为自己什么都怕……可直到遇见她，那些恐惧才乘以一个大到我根本无法{i}想象{/i}的数字。

lines.en: So maybe it wasn’t ever fear at all back then. And maybe it was something else.
lines.zh: 所以也许那时候的根本就不是恐惧。也许是别的什么。

lines.en: That all seems so distant now, though.
lines.zh: 不过，那一切现在都显得那么遥远。

lines.en: : Do you ever wish you could just, like...stop the clock? And live in a single moment for the rest of your life?
lines.zh: : 你有没有过那种……想让时钟停下来的念头？然后就此活在某一个瞬间里，直到生命尽头？

lines.en: : Yeah...
: I think we all do sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我想大家有时候都会这么想。

lines.en: : Do you feel that way right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在有这种感觉吗？

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : I asked you first.
lines.zh: : 是我先问的。

lines.en: : Yeah. But my answer is embarrassing, so I want you to go.
lines.zh: : 有。不过我的答案有点难为情，所以我想让你先说。

lines.en: : So is mine! And {i}you’re{/i} the adult here, so I think you should be the one setting an example.
lines.zh: : 我的也一样！而且{i}你{/i}是大人，我觉得你该以身作则。

lines.en: : Then yes. I {i}do{/i} feel that way right now.
lines.zh: : 那好。我现在{i}确实{/i}有这种感觉。

lines.en: : I feel it every moment I look at you.
lines.zh: : 我看着你的每一刻都有这种感觉。

lines.en: : Wow. That {i}is{/i} embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 哇。那{i}确实{/i}挺难为情的。

lines.en: : I told you.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。

lines.en: : You think Mom is the same way?
lines.zh: : 你觉得妈妈也一样吗？

lines.en: : I {i}know{/i} she’s the same way.
lines.zh: : 我{i}知道{/i}她也一样。

lines.en: : You know that, before you were born, she used to talk about wanting a {i}ton{/i} of children? Like...a staggering amount of them.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，在你出生之前，她总说想要{i}一大堆{/i}孩子？就是……多得吓人的那种。

lines.en: : And she called it quits after just one? Was I that much of a terror as a baby?
lines.zh: : 然后她生了一个就收手了？我小时候有那么可怕吗？

lines.en: : The opposite. I think she just loved you so much that the idea of having to {i}split{/i} that love seemed unfair to you.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。我想她是太爱你了，觉得要把这份爱{i}分{/i}给别人，对你不公平。

lines.en: : Do you think I’d make a good sister?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会是个好姐姐吗？

lines.en: : I think you’d make a good {i}anything.{/i} Which is why I live each day in an incessant state of shock now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不管当{i}什么{/i}都很好。所以我现在每天都活在没完没了的震惊里。

lines.en: : To think that you came from {i}me,{/i} just...
lines.zh: : 想想看，你竟然是从{i}我{/i}来的，就……

lines.en: : I can’t comprehend it.
lines.zh: : 我怎么都想不明白。

lines.en: : You’re pretty great too, you know.
lines.zh: : 你也挺了不起的，知道吗。

lines.en: : Maybe not back in the day. But I didn’t know you then, so all {i}I{/i} can really do is judge you based on now.  On what I {i}have{/i} seen.
lines.zh: : 也许以前不是。但那时候我还不认识你，所以{i}我{/i}只能根据现在来判断你。根据我{i}看到{/i}的一切。

lines.en: : I don’t want to grow up.
lines.zh: : 我不想长大。

lines.en: : You’re going to have to.
lines.zh: : 那你也不得不大。

lines.en: : Are you guys going to kick me out when I turn eighteen?
lines.zh: : 等我满十八岁，你们会把我赶出去吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But I think you’re too smart to let yourself grow old in our house. And that you’ll eventually {i}want{/i} to leave if you don’t already.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。但我觉得你太聪明了，不会让自己在这栋房子里老去。而且就算你现在{i}不想{/i}走，总有一天也会想走的。

lines.en: : What does being smart have to do with a person’s feelings? I can be a genius and still not want to leave your side.
lines.zh: : 聪不聪明跟一个人的感情有什么关系？我可以是天才，却照样不想离开你身边。

lines.en: : You could. But then the world would miss out on someone who could change it for the better.
lines.zh: : 你可以那样。但那样一来，这个世界就会错过一个能让它变得更好的人。

lines.en: : Well, maybe I’m just an asshole then. Because I don’t really care about other people.
lines.zh: : 那也许我就是个混蛋吧。因为我其实并不在乎别人。

lines.en: : Finally, you take after me in some way. And here I thought you were just a newer version of your mom.
lines.zh: : 总算有地方像我了。我还以为你只是你妈的新版本呢。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? No wonder why you love me so much.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？难怪你这么爱我。

lines.en: : I’d still love you even if you were nothing like her.
lines.zh: : 就算你一点也不像她，我也一样爱你。

lines.en: : You mean it?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : You really are the light of my life.
lines.zh: : 你真的是我生命中的光。

lines.en: : I can’t explain how much you’ve changed me in such a short amount of time.
lines.zh: : 我说不清你在这么短的时间里改变了我多少。

lines.en: scene black
scene himadate31
: Can you try? I like it when you compliment me. It feels like I’m being wrapped in a big, warm dad-blanket.
lines.zh: : 你能不能试着说说看？我喜欢你夸我。那感觉就像被一条又大又暖的爸爸牌毯子裹住一样。

lines.en: : I’ve already told you I love you and that’s taxing enough as someone who never learned how to properly express himself.
lines.zh: : 我都已经跟你说过我爱你了，对一个从来没学会好好表达自己的人来说，这已经够累人的了。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s too late to learn if you really try. Mom always says I get you closer to smiling than anybody else. That’s a good first step, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我觉得只要你真的努力，现在学也不算晚。妈妈总说，我比任何人都更能让你接近微笑。那是个不错的开始，对吧？

lines.en: : You don’t {i}want{/i} me to get better at expressing myself. You’d literally never hear the end of it.
lines.zh: : 你可不会{i}想{/i}让我学会表达。不然我的话你听都听不完。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t need to if I could stop the clock.
lines.zh: : 如果我能让时钟停下，也就不需要了。

lines.en: : I could listen to you...and look at you forever. And if you ever need to catch your breath, you can let me pick up the slack so I can try to express myself too.
lines.zh: : 我可以一直听你说话……一直看着你。如果你需要喘口气，就让我接上，这样我也能试着表达自己。

lines.en: : I’m probably worse at it than you think, though. I’m just not as good at finding the right words as you.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概比你以为的还要差。我只是没你那么会找合适的词。

lines.en: : Well, your mom’s also the type to let her actions speak louder than those. There are just two different types of people, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你妈也是那种让行动胜过言语的人。我想人就是分这么两种吧。

lines.en: : I hope I can make you understand one day...just how much you really mean to me.
lines.zh: : 我希望有一天能让你明白……你对我来说到底有多重要。

lines.en: : You will.
lines.zh: : 你会的。

lines.en: : I already know it.
lines.zh: : 我已经知道了。

lines.en: : I just don’t think it’s really hit me yet.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得那种感觉还没真正击中我。

lines.en: : Well, when it does, can you let me know? Because giving 100%% every minute of every day sounds like it could get exhausting.
lines.zh: : 那等它击中的时候，能告诉我一声吗？因为每一天的每一分钟都付出 100%% 听起来会很累。

lines.en: : And sometimes, it’s nice to just sit back and relax with someone you love. Right, Dad?
lines.zh: : 而且有时候，能和你爱的人一起坐下来放松一下，也挺好的。对吧，爸爸？

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 对啊……

lines.en: scene himadate32
: The view from here is beautiful, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 从这儿看出去的风景真美，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...
scene black
: It really is.
lines.zh: : 真的很美。
